purpose: Measure deployment throughput and queueing for one typed judgment per HTTP request; distinguish text versus fixed-size image input
identity: BF16 JEV-27B-VL System1, TP2 NPU, eager; full decision adapter; no CPU offload
correctness_required: startup + text + vision + batch parity pass before scoring
scope: new independent benchmark; not directly comparable to original three-question bundled req/s
percentile_method: nearest rank; P95/P90 >=128, P99 >=662; independent runs, no pooling

workloads.text: Original short 800-character states; fixed routing Choice only, 64 cases
workloads.vision: First 16 frozen CharXiv inputs, resize to 448x448 bounding box, fixed same cases across restarts; one image and one Choice

cache: prefix disabled, no result cache; record multimodal processor cache defaults separately, repeated images warm the processor cache
results: success req/s = successful requests / complete-drain wall time
NPU AICore/HBM/power time series sampled ~1Hz, actual gaps retained
no_production_slo: Closed-loop diagnostic, not sustainable open-loop capacity or business-SLO guarantee
remainder: Original decider full performance workflow remains separately outstanding

cache_warmup_amendment.warmup: Warm every frozen workload input (64 text,16 images) before its concurrency sweep; all repeated image processor inputs are warm even at C1. Prefix/KV reuse stays disabled.
cache_warmup_amendment.reason: 8-of-16 image warmup would leave C1 partly cold and later concurrency points warm.
